mechanics.definition: 在不建立新付费入口的情况下，按独立重转计数重新生成全部或部分盘面；结果不要求形成持续累积的奖值占格终局。step_index_semantics固定为executed_respin_action_index_1_based，从1开始按Feature内实际执行重转动作递增。

conditional_packages.when: entry_source_semantics至少声明一个endogenous游戏内生入口来源；只有一个内生来源时保留退化支持不适用实例，两个及以上时评分

保留位置跨重转步骤形成命名的state.persistent-state(position_set)，且具体位置身份影响后续规则或可见体验；atomic.respin拥有按实际执行步骤的保留数量、给定保留数量后的重转数量及给定两类数量后的重转位置份额，atomic.persistent-state拥有自身观测点的数量边际、条件位置份额、数量转移及移除/新增位置依赖残差。同一事件域与观测点重复时，只允许按原版步骤暴露和数量权重把更细Respin目标边际化为持久状态目标，不允许反向恢复按步骤Respin目标

evidence_signatures: protocol or state exposes an independent respin counter
rerolled and retained positions are identifiable for every respin step
exclusions: Cascade derived directly from a previous settlement
qualifying prize positions accumulate toward one terminal locked-board award

mechanics.definition: 在有限容量盘面中持续锁定新获得的合格奖值对象，新锁定通常重置或增加剩余重转次数，并在终局统一结算锁定内容。固定容量只把board_capacity作为占用指标的常量条件，不实例化容量指标；容量可变时必须密封实际容量域、入口/步骤开始/终局容量观察点及逐步容量转移规则，并按P(C)×P(O|C)×P(C'|C,O)×P(O'|C,O,C')非重叠拆分容量与占用过程。

conditional_packages.when: entry_source_semantics至少声明一个endogenous游戏内生入口来源；只有一个内生来源时保留退化支持不适用实例，两个及以上时评分

锁定位置跨步骤形成命名的state.persistent-state(position_set)，已密封稳定position_domain，且具体位置身份影响后续落入、结算、收集、升级或可见体验；同一state_id与位置域的占用数量边际及数量推进统一由atomic.hold-and-spin承接，persistent_state.occupied_position_count_distribution与persistent_state.position_count_transition_distribution必须标记不适用；保留的条件位置份额和移除/新增位置依赖残差必须通过position_count_owner_bindings精确引用对应Hold & Spin数量Owner实例
锁定对象携带动态金额、倍率或奖项
终局或锁定对象可授予命名Jackpot层级
玩法内存在独立Collect聚合事件；collector_rule必须通过collect_node_ids引用活动modifier.collect节点并共享语义事件集

evidence_signatures: locked qualifying positions persist between respin steps
new locks and remaining-spin reset or extension are observable
terminal payout is reproducible from the final locked state
collector_rule, when present, binds every Collect consumer through collect_node_ids to active modifier.collect nodes on a shared semantic event set

variable_capacity_rule or unlock_or_upgrade_rule, when present, requires capacity_transition_contract to seal a complete actual_capacity_domain, entry/step_start/terminal capacity observations, every reachable current-capacity/current-occupancy group, its reachable next-capacity domain, exact step-boundary timing, and any deterministic primary-owner pushforward bindings

when concrete locked positions matter under variable capacity, the linked position_set state seals position_domain_by_actual_capacity and all spatial metric instances include the matching actual capacity context
exclusions: ordinary respin with no accumulating terminal locked-board value
sticky symbols inside free spins without an independent hold-and-spin counter
Cascade where removed cells are refilled after wins
